title: CostEstimate
description: Returned by estimate_session(). Provides pre-flight cost estimation without performing any LLM calls.

estimated_input_tokens.description: Estimated cumulative input tokens across all windows.

estimated_output_tokens.description: Estimated cumulative output tokens across all windows.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD. NULL if provider pricing not supplied.

confidence.description: Estimation confidence. 'high' = known task pattern, 'low' = novel task.
